data.exact_reserve_text: As a result of the settlements made and the uncertainty of outcomes, we have increased our loss reserves by a further GBP 128.9m gross and GBP 29.3m net of reinsurance recoveries. The reserves for all claims related to the western-leased aircraft in Russia now stand at GBP 393.4m gross and GBP 113.8m net of reinsurance (31 December 2023 - GBP 264.5m gross, GBP 84.5m net of reinsurance) as at 31 December 2024. The casualty business group experienced deterioration to the prior year reserves as a result of construction defect claims in Florida. Due to the continued adverse development seen during the year additional gross reserves of GBP 52.7m and GBP 52.3m net of reinsurance were recorded bringing the overall gross reserves for this class to GBP 132.0m (2023 - GBP 79.4m).
specific_events: Western leased aircraft in Russia (Russia/Ukraine exposures)
Florida construction defect (Artisans / US Contractors GL)

prior_year_events.impact_description: Significant adverse development on reserves relating to western-leased aircraft held in Russia; ultimate gross reserves increased to GBP 393.4m (from GBP 264.5m) as at 31 December 2024.

prior_year_events.event_name: Florida construction defect claims (Artisans / US Contractors GL)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Deterioration on prior year reserves for US Contractors General Liability due to construction defect litigation in Florida; gross reserves increased to GBP 132.0m (from GBP 79.4m).

named_events.loss_description: Syndicate has exposure of GBP 64.1m gross and GBP 7.3m net of reinsurance; significant shipping/cargo loss across Marine and related classes.
Gross and net losses (2024) impacting property and related classes; reported contribution to gross and net loss ratios.
Recorded loss reserved to the syndicate; reported alongside Milton as 2024 catastrophe activity.
Reserve for this loss reduced slightly over the year and now stands at GBP 24.2m gross and GBP 24.1m net of reinsurance recoveries.
Overall loss quantum to the syndicate still to be determined; industry loss estimates $30bn-$50bn.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2024 the syndicate's gross claims reserves at the start of the year were GBP 1,285.3m. During 2024 there was material adverse prior-year development totalling approximately GBP 181.6m gross, driven primarily by: (i) increased reserves for western-leased aircraft in Russia (gross increase c.GBP 128.9m) affecting Aviation, Marine and related reinsurance classes; and (ii) adverse development on US Contractors General Liability (Florida construction defect) with a gross increase of c.GBP 52.7m affecting Casualty. The 2021 year of account remains open due to continued uncertainty around the Russia aviation exposures. Several large 2024 events (e.g. Dali bridge collapse, Hurricanes Milton/Helene and Californian wildfires) impacted current-year loss activity but were not the primary driver of the prior-year reserve strengthening.
raw_causal_phrases: the syndicate has exposure to the fate of the western leased aircraft in Russia
deterioration to the prior year reserves as a result of construction defect claims in Florida
we have increased our loss reserves by a further GBP 128.9m gross and GBP 29.3m net of reinsurance recoveries
additional gross reserves of GBP 52.7m and GBP 52.3m net of reinsurance were recorded
Due to the nature of the circumstances mentioned above, the potential for variation to the booked reserves is considerably greater than the normal level of reserve sensitivity to downside risk

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken directly from the Balance Sheet (Liabilities: Claims outstanding). Prior year development (gross) computed from explicit narrative movements disclosed in the report (increase of GBP 128.9m for Russia aviation exposures and GBP 52.7m for Florida contractors). No single 'Movement in prior year's provision' gross-line item was present; the prior year figure is the sum of explicit gross increases disclosed in the Directors'/Underwriter's narrative. The claims development triangle is present but includes an 'X and prior' aggregate in other areas; RITC and LPT activity (notably the LPT executed 13 Jan 2025) may distort development measures post year-end. All monetary amounts are in millions. Some current-year named event amounts are presented as gross/net where available; several event impacts remain undetermined and are left null.
